label.explanation: A enrichment-svc reconciler session opened transaction 87799 on events-db and left it open holding a row lock on events (line 168). Subsequent updates queued behind that lock (lines 176, 189, 192), so enrichment-svc's queries hit their statement timeout and ingest-api's calls to enrichment-svc timed out (lines 187, 188, 194, 195, 200, 201). ingest-api's connection pool to enrichment-svc saturating (lines 203, 206, 216, 233) and the ingest-gateway 504s (lines 199, 204, 210, 214, 215, 224, 228, 234, 237, 239, 245, 252) are downstream symptoms. The fix is to kill the idle-in-transaction session, not to add capacity. Red herrings: line 88 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full); line 157 (a client sending one invalid request, rejected correctly with a 400); line 182 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits); line 183 (one malformed message that was dead-lettered correctly; the consumer kept going).
